subject.title: fix(codex): rotate bounded-turn auth profiles on usage limits

question: Should unpinned bounded Codex app-server turns rotate through backup OpenAI auth profiles and persist existing usage-limit blocks to `usageStats`, matching chat attempts?
rationale: The implementation looks correct, but it intentionally changes auth-provider routing and persisted profile-blocking behavior for existing multi-profile setups.

options.title: Accept bounded auth rotation
options.body: Land the PR after owner review confirms bounded turns should use the existing failover order and usageStats blocking behavior.

options.title: Pause for explicit opt-in policy
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want bounded turns to remain single-profile by default or require a new explicit policy before rotating.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded auth rotation
recommendation.body: Land the PR after owner review confirms bounded turns should use the existing failover order and usageStats blocking behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex app-server, rate-limit, and auth-routing history makes this the best available owner for the merge-risk decision.
